purpose: Explicit evaluator grouping rules. These rules do not enable runtime filtering or assert that filters have been tested.
rules: Reuse of evidence is not duplication when checked objects or relations differ.
Exact repeated subclaims count once; retain every source ID and mandatory location.
Partial coverage remains partial; an umbrella statement does not cover all objects.
Unknown and conditional consequences stay outside the technical denominator.
